speaker: Captain Maren
text: The pressure locks groan around you. Somewhere in the drowned archive, a route chart still remembers the sky.

speaker: Commander Rex
text: The fortress still holds formation over the clouds. Its command spine is damaged, but not dead.

speaker: Clockmaker Echo
text: Every corridor here was built with intention. If a command sigil survived anywhere, it would be in this sanctum.

speaker: The Watcher
text: The rift is not a place. It is a wound. Walk carefully, and listen for what the world is trying to forget.

speaker: The Watcher
text: Memory Lane lies ahead. Beyond it waits the Gauntlet of Trials, the Throne of Origin, and the last answer Mechara can give.

speaker: Bolt Simulation
text: Challenge loop initialized. Descend, adapt, and return stronger. The dungeon does not end; it measures.

speaker: Edda
text: The Elder Drake falls, and the warding pylons hum back to life across Dragon Peak.

speaker: Commander Rex
text: Volt Specter dissipates into the cloud deck. The fortress command lanes deeper inside are open now.

speaker: Forge Core
text: The Ancient Phoenix is broken, and the Volcanic Core settles into a forgeable rhythm.

speaker: Clockmaker Echo
text: With the Clockwork Bishop defeated, the sanctum's preserved command vaults stand unguarded.

speaker: The Watcher
text: The Unmaker falls silent, and something bright remains where the breach was deepest.

speaker: The Watcher
text: Origin collapses into silence. For the first time in ages, the world feels like it might belong to the living again.

speaker: Bolt Simulation
text: Apex Predator defeated. The trial resets, but your mastery remains recorded in the ruin.

speaker: Edda
text: The Elder Drake chose to yield rather than fall completely. It will bear your crew from peak to frontier now. Find the dragon roosts and it will answer.

speaker: Nia
text: This is what's out here past the mountain. Rough terrain, old iron, and more frontier than anyone in Ironhaven realized.

speaker: Nia
text: There it is — a pulse from the deep shelf. That rhythm isn't natural. Something down there is still running on old power.

speaker: Bram
text: Beyond Ironhaven's east gate the frontier stops pretending to be tame. Verdant Fields is the first live stretch, so keep your formation tight and don't drift.

speaker: Ranger Pell
text: Even the trees here have memory. Walk quietly and the forest will tell you where the danger sits before it finds you.

speaker: Jora
text: Old iron, old machinery, old grudges. The quarry has been running on borrowed time for years. Watch the crusher lines.

speaker: Reno
text: The shallows look calm until they don't. Every salvage run out here is a negotiation with the tide.

speaker: Professor Lio
text: Crystal resonance at this depth predates the collapse by centuries. Tread carefully — the formations here are still learning what they are.

speaker: Forge Core
text: Heat signatures off the charts. The plateau has been burning since before any of us arrived. Don't let your frames overheat out here.

speaker: Sister Vale
text: The cold here is older than the cloister. Whatever the vale is preserving, it doesn't intend to thaw until it's ready.

speaker: Edda
text: The air up here changes you if you stay long enough. The Elder Drake watches the peak from somewhere above. It knows you're here.

speaker: Forgehand Kira
text: The core doesn't forgive error. Every degree matters down here. Keep your frames cool and your nerve steady.

speaker: Sister Vale
text: The vale's cold finally stops fighting back. Whatever held the cloister's old circuit in ice just let go.

speaker: Professor Lio
text: The Crystal Wyrm falls silent and the resonance chambers finally hold a stable harmonic. These depths are a laboratory again.

speaker: Forge Core
text: With the Ember Hound pack broken, the plateau heat begins to cycle down to something workable. Kira's forge accord just became viable.
